name: greeter
title: The greeter nobody visited
tagline: It learned one word, hello, and waited at the door.

chapters.heading: Hello, world
paragraphs: The greeter was born on the 7th of September 2016, in block 2,217,797, in the DAO Fork age.
It knew how to say one thing back to anyone who asked.

chapters.heading: The door that never opened
paragraphs: Nobody ever asked. Not one call has reached it since the day it was born.
